description.zh:
该参数已废弃。

> 该参数表示黑名单IP的有效期。白名单IP默认永久有效，无需设置该参数。
description.en:
This parameter is deprecated.

> This parameter specifies the validity period of blacklist IP addresses. Whitelist IP addresses are permanently valid by default. You do not need to set this parameter.

description.zh:
要添加白名单IP的DDoS高防实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~)查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance for which you want to add whitelist IP addresses.

> You can call [DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~) to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Proxy instances.

description.zh:
要添加的白名单IP的配置。使用JSON数组转化的字符串表示。JSON数组的每个元素是一个白名单IP结构体，具体包含以下参数：

- **src**：String类型 | 必选 | 要添加到白名单的IP地址。
description.en:
The configuration of the whitelist IP addresses that you want to add. This parameter is a string that is converted from a JSON array. Each element in the JSON array is a struct of a whitelist IP address that contains the following parameter:

- **src**: String type | Required | The IP address that you want to add to the whitelist.

title.zh: 添加针对DDoS高防实例的白名单IP

descriptions.zh:
本接口用于为单个DDoS高防实例添加白名单IP，使DDoS高防实例直接放行指定IP的请求流量。

白名单IP经添加后，默认永久有效。如果后续不再需要白名单IP，您可以调用[EmptyAutoCcWhitelist](~~157505~~)清空已添加的白名单IP列表。

### QPS限制

本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
This operation adds whitelist IP addresses for a single Anti-DDoS instance, allowing the Anti-DDoS instance to directly forward request traffic from the specified IP addresses.

By default, whitelist IP addresses are permanently valid once added. If you no longer need a whitelist IP address, you can call [EmptyAutoCcWhitelist](~~157505~~) to remove all added whitelist IP addresses.

### QPS limits

The queries per second (QPS) limit for this operation is 10 per second per user. If the limit is exceeded, API calls will be throttled, which may affect your business. We recommend that you call this operation at an appropriate rate.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo add-auto-cc-whitelist --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --whitelist src_:_192.XX.XX.1_,_src_:_192.XX.XX.2 --expire-time 0 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
